dialogue.content: Hi! I started last week (hybrid, Oakland office) and my badge finally works. Which days am I actually required to be in the office? It's September 2026, if that matters.

For September 2026, you're required to be in the office **at least 3 days each week**, with **Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday** as the anchor days.

That comes from the People announcement "Three In-Office Days for Hybrid Teams" (posted 2026-05-04, effective 2026-06-01), which explicitly replaced the older two-day (Tuesday/Thursday) expectation in Section 3 of the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy (HR-110) and the summary in Section 7 of the Employee Handbook. The New Hire Onboarding Guide reflects the same three-day rule.

A few practical notes:
- Your offer letter confirms your hybrid classification (hybrid employees live within 50 miles of a Cardinal office).
- If you can't make an anchor day, tell your manager ahead of time.
- Coming in on Monday or Friday is optional — just book a desk in DeskSpot, since some neighborhoods are shared seating.
